# Application commands

Model parameters are declared separately in shared.json. Session identity and read receipts belong to application commands.

results.json declares JSON response DTOs, including read variants and unsuccessful Job dispatch replies. It generates CommandResults and command-specific transport return types. Response schemas are checked against actual API replies in tests; production does not validate responses.

| Command | Required parameters | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `research.read` |  | read |
| `research.search` |  | read |
| `research.create` | `goal` | write |
| `research.update` | `node_id`, `note` | write |
| `research.result` | `node_id`, `conclusion` | write |
| `research.source` | `session_id`, `message_id`, `text` | write |
| `research.observe` | `read_basis` | write |
| `job.start` |  |  |
| `job.status` |  |  |
| `job.collect` |  |  |
| `job.cancel` |  |  |
| `job.probe` |  |  |
| `job.reconcile` |  |  |
| `job.prepare` | `request_file` | write |
| `job.resolve_prepared` | `prepared_ref` | read |
| `job.monitor_assess` | `event_id`, `session_id` | read |
| `job.list` |  | read |
| `artifact.register` |  |  |
| `artifact.create` |  |  |
| `artifact.read` |  |  |
